name: Billionbrains Garage Ventures Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2017, Groww is a Bengaluru-based fintech company that provides retail investors direct-to-customer digital investment platform, providing multiple financial products and services. [1]
key_points: Business Overview [1] Billionbrains Garage Ventures (Groww) is India’s largest digital investment platform by active users on the NSE as of June 2025. The company operates a direct-to-customer model offering a wide range of financial products, including stocks, derivatives, bonds, mutual funds, margin trading facilities, and personal loans. Its technology-first approach and intuitive app design have driven widespread adoption across India’s cities and rural markets.

profile.summary: Billionbrains Garage Ventures Limited develops a direct-to-customer digital investment platform that provides wealth creation opportunities through multiple financial products and services in India. Its platform Groww, allows users to invest in and trade stocks, including cash, intraday, and IPO; equity and commodity derivatives; bonds; mutual funds; margin trading facility; exchange traded funds; personal loans, loan against securities; and other products. The company also offers Groww Lite, a secure, lightweight, web-based trading platform accessible on both desktop and mobile browsers; as well as Groww Charts, a mobile charting platform that helps users trade smarter. In addition, it provides content, such as financial literacy resources, news, and information through Groww Digest, blogs and newsletters. Billionbrains Garage Ventures Limited was founded in 2016 and is based in Bengaluru, India.
